title: PIM for Active Directory: install and configure the hybrid worker on the worker machine
purpose: Installs and configures the PIM for Active Directory hybrid worker on the worker machine itself (an Azure VM or an Azure Arc-enabled on-premises server): the gMSAs, the PIM code for its update ring and the scheduled tasks.
whenToRun: On the worker, as SYSTEM or a local administrator -- normally delivered through run-command by Invoke-PimHybridWorkerRunCommand.ps1: -Phase Join (Azure VM, then it reboots), -Phase Configure after the grants (with -PlanOnly first if you like). The daily task runs -Phase Update by itself.

runAs.name: Local Administrator / SYSTEM on the worker (run-command runs it as SYSTEM)
runAs.why: installs PowerShell 7, the gMSAs, user rights, the C:\PIM folder and scheduled tasks

changes.target: the worker machine (-Phase Join, Azure VM)
changes.object: offline domain join from the blob, then a reboot
changes.why: the Azure VM joins the domain without line of sight

changes.object: PowerShell 7 (Microsoft-signed MSI from github.com); the gMSA(s) installed and tested; 'log on as a batch job' for them; C:\PIM (inheritance removed: SYSTEM + Administrators write, the gMSAs read); the PIM code for the ring; the run wrapper; six scheduled tasks (PIM Hybrid Worker, PIM Hybrid AD Sync, PIM Hybrid AD Sync Servers, PIM Hybrid AD Changes, PIM Hybrid Servers with -ServerGmsaName, PIM Hybrid Worker Update)
changes.why: the worker itself; no password, secret or certificate is stored
changes.undo: delete the 'PIM Hybrid *' scheduled tasks and C:\PIM; remove the gMSAs from 'log on as a batch job'

changes.object: the gMSA(s) added to the local group 'Hybrid agent extension applications' (never Administrators)
changes.why: the tasks run as the gMSAs and must answer the Arc agent's key-file challenge for the machine identity

changes.object: the machine account password is changed once (nltest /sc_change_pwd)

changes.target: the worker machine (Azure VM: -Phase Configure, Layout, Update and MetadataAccess)
changes.object: one outbound Windows Firewall rule, 'PIM Hybrid Worker - metadata service access': the instance metadata service (169.254.169.254, TCP 80) answers only SYSTEM (the Azure VM agent and its extensions), the worker's gMSAs and the gMSA of each product registered on the machine (C:\ProgramData\HybridWorkerHost\guests); every other account is blocked. Replaced on each run; the accounts are printed with their SIDs, and a warning names any account that cannot be resolved. Not on an Azure Arc server
changes.why: only the accounts that need the machine's managed identities can ask for their tokens

changes.object: the six scheduled tasks, the gMSA(s) from 'Hybrid agent extension applications' (Arc) and from 'log on as a batch job', the metadata-service firewall rule, C:\PIM\app and C:\PIM\bin (logs kept); the machine, its agent, PowerShell 7 and the domain membership stay

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.help: Join (Azure VM), Configure, Update, Layout, Remove (unregister the worker's tasks and rights on this machine; Remove-PimHybridWorker.ps1 -Target Arc runs it), Guests (read only: lists the other products registered on this machine; Remove-PimHybridWorker.ps1 runs it before it removes a VM), or MetadataAccess (Azure VM: re-applies only the metadata-service rule; a product that registers on or leaves this machine runs C:\PIM\bin\Install-PimHybridWorker.ps1 -Phase MetadataAccess as SYSTEM right after).

parameters.name: ServerGmsaName
parameters.help: DOMAIN\gMSA-PIM-L2-T1 for server onboarding in its own task.

parameters.name: SqlServer
parameters.help: -Phase Configure (required): the PIM SQL server FQDN.

parameters.name: SourceContainerUrl
parameters.help: -Phase Configure (required): https://<store>.blob.core.windows.net/<container> with the PIM code and channel.json.

parameters.name: UpdateSource
parameters.help: -Phase Configure: where the worker's daily update comes from. Invardia (the default): the Invardia update service, for the worker's own release ring. Blob: the source container above, for an installation that does not use Invardia.

parameters.name: Ring
parameters.help: The update ring the worker follows (the environment's).

parameters.name: Version
parameters.help: Pin a version instead of a ring.

parameters.name: AdServer
parameters.help: A specific domain controller for the worker's AD calls.

parameters.name: PlanOnly
parameters.help: Every run plans and logs, nothing is written to AD until Configure is re-run without it.

parameters.name: HostType
parameters.help: Auto, AzureVm (IMDS identity) or Arc (the Azure Arc agent's identity).

readsOnly: the domain-join state, the host type (the himds service / the Arc variables), channel.json for the ring, the installed version, the registered guests (C:\ProgramData\HybridWorkerHost\guests\*.json) and the account names they and worker.json give
network: the source store (<store>.blob.core.windows.net) with the machine identity; api.github.com / github.com / objects.githubusercontent.com once (PowerShell 7); the identity endpoint on the machine (IMDS on an Azure VM, the Arc agent on localhost:40342). Modules: only the owner-approved in-box Windows ScheduledTasks, CimCmdlets and NetSecurity (Windows Firewall) (framework 12.17); no ActiveDirectory module
whatIf: Prints what the phase would do on this host (join, gMSAs, Arc group, the code, the six tasks and the metadata-service rule with the accounts it lets through) and changes nothing.
undo: Delete the 'PIM Hybrid *' scheduled tasks, the firewall rule 'PIM Hybrid Worker - metadata service access' and C:\PIM; on Arc remove the gMSAs from 'Hybrid agent extension applications'.
